description: Load one campaign's full report — delivery, open, click, click-to-open and bounce rates plus campaign metadata. Use after you have identified a campaign of interest. Returns a fixed-size set of campaign-level aggregates in one call regardless of audience size; per-variant, funnel and geography breakdowns are on sm_get_variate, not here.

campaignId.description: The opaque string identifier for the campaign as assigned by Mailchimp. List campaigns to obtain this ID. If the ID is invalid or does not exist in the project, the endpoint will return a 404 error.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

name: sm_get_campaign

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_campaign tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

campaignMeta.description: Metadata for a campaign, including raw stringified JSON variate settings. May be null.

campaignType.description: Mailchimp campaign type, or null when unknown.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

performance.description: Detailed performance for individual campaigns. May be null.

bounceRate.description: Bounces divided by emails sent, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

clickRate.description: Unique clicks divided by delivered, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

clickToOpenRate.description: Unique clicks divided by unique opens, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

clicksTotal.description: Total click events, counting repeat clicks.

deliveries.description: Number of emails accepted for delivery by the receiving mail system.

deliveryRate.description: Delivered divided by emails sent, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

openRate.description: Unique opens divided by delivered, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

opensTotal.description: Total open events, counting repeat opens by the same member.

totalBounces.description: Hard plus soft bounces for the campaign.

uniqueClicks.description: Number of distinct members who clicked at least once.

uniqueOpens.description: Number of distinct members who opened at least once.

unsubscribeRate.description: Unsubscribes divided by delivered, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.

report.description: Comprehensive details for a single campaign. May be null.

abuseReports.description: Number of recipients who reported the campaign as spam.

bounceRate.description: Bounces divided by emails sent, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

campaignId.description: Stable identifier for a Mailchimp campaign. Use it to join rows across tools or drill into sm_get_campaign.

clickRate.description: Unique clicks divided by delivered, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

clickToOpenRate.description: Unique clicks divided by unique opens, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

delivered.description: Number of emails accepted for delivery by the receiving mail system.

deliveryRate.description: Delivered divided by emails sent, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

emailsSent.description: Number of emails the campaign attempted to send to recipients.

forwardsCount.description: Number of forward events. Forwards are not a working metric and must never be used to rank, recommend, or brief.

hardBounces.description: Emails rejected for permanent reasons such as an invalid address. Not retried.

listName.description: Audience the campaign was sent to.

openRate.description: Unique opens divided by delivered, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

softBounces.description: Emails rejected for temporary reasons. Mailchimp may retry delivery.

subjectLine.description: The campaign subject line as sent.

totalClicks.description: Total click events, counting repeat clicks.

totalOpens.description: Total open events, counting repeat opens by the same member.

uniqueClicks.description: Number of distinct members who clicked at least once.

uniqueOpens.description: Number of distinct members who opened at least once.

unsubscribes.description: Number of unsubscribe events for the campaign.

title: Get campaign report
